standard-dialogue-using-a-guthix-balance.npc: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.

standard-dialogue-using-a-guthix-balance.text: You're handed a certificate of treasure as a reward.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-them-again.npc: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
